name: Spelunkr TV
description: Adds spelunkr.tv channels (24/7 channels of old films and shows from the Internet Archive) to Live TV, with a TV guide. No setup: install, restart Jellyfin, open Live TV. It also sets Live TV to open on the Guide for every account that hasn't picked a Live TV default screen; turn that off on the plugin's settings page.
overview: Spelunkr.tv channels in Live TV, with a guide
